title: One structural class, one treatment? Firmonertinib in PACC-mutant NSCLC.
abstract: EGFR PACC-mutant non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) has limited treatment options.

In this issue of Cancer Cell, Le et al. report preclinical profiles and promising systemic and intracranial efficacy of the broad-spectrum CNS-penetrant tyrosine kinase inhibitor firmonertinib in PACC-mutant NSCLC, supporting its further clinical development in this challenging mutation class.
